description: This file defines the public API for PCIe controller drivers in Zephyr, including function prototypes, callback types, and data structures for configuration, memory region management, and enumeration.

methods.name: pcie_ctrl_conf_read
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit word from an endpoint's configuration space using the controller API.

methods.name: pcie_ctrl_conf_write
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit word to an endpoint's configuration space using the controller API.

methods.name: pcie_ctrl_region_allocate
methods.description: Allocates a memory region for an endpoint's Base Address Register.

methods.name: pcie_ctrl_region_get_allocate_base
methods.description: Gets the current allocation base address for an endpoint's memory region.

methods.name: pcie_ctrl_region_translate
methods.description: Translates a bus-centric address in a BAR to a physical address.

methods.name: pcie_ctrl_msi_device_setup
methods.description: Sets up MSI device for PCIe controller if MSI is supported.
